gaps.sentence: Insure the camera ___ it gets damaged in transit.
gaps.explanation: 'In case it gets damaged' = as a precaution against damage.

gaps.sentence: I can't afford a holiday this year; ___, I can't get the time off work.
gaps.explanation: 'Besides' adds a further, often decisive, reason in informal style.

gaps.sentence: ___ had I closed my eyes than the alarm went off.
gaps.explanation: The 'than' in the sentence forces 'No sooner', the only linker paired with than.

gaps.sentence: The negotiations dragged on for months, but they ___ collapsed.
gaps.explanation: 'Eventually' signals the outcome after much delay.

gaps.sentence: I'll take the job ___ they don't offer me any more money.
gaps.explanation: 'Even if' concedes a future possibility that will not change the decision.

gaps.sentence: ___ the price, the location is absolutely perfect.
gaps.explanation: 'Apart from the price' = the only negative in an otherwise positive description.

gaps.sentence: The delegates arrived early ___ have time to network.
gaps.explanation: 'So as to + infinitive' = in order to, a formal purpose linker.

gaps.sentence: The old system charged per download, ___ the new one uses a flat monthly fee.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' sets the old and new systems side by side.
